title: VI Analyzer normalized report (cross-plane input, LBA-REQ-015)
description: The normalized shape a plane's parser emits from a real LabVIEWCLI RunVIAnalyzer report (ni/labview-icon-editor .viancfg pattern). summarizeViAnalyzerReport canonicalizes this into comparable metrics + a deterministic, order-independent, locale-independent resultHash (the LBA-REQ-015 cross-plane anchor). Two planes summarizing the SAME committed report produce byte-identical resultHash, so a VI Analyzer run becomes a cross-plane-comparable benchmark. To keep the committed report portable and the digest stable, viPath SHOULD be repo-relative with forward slashes and stable casing; the resultHash canonicalizes over the exact viPath and test strings.

config.description: The VI Analyzer configuration identity (e.g. the .viancfg name). Carried through as summary.config; does not affect the resultHash.

vis.description: Per-VI results. Each viPath MUST be unique (a duplicate makes the resultHash ambiguous).

viPath.description: Repo-relative, forward-slash, case-stable path. MUST be normalized identically cross-plane.

tests.description: Per-test results for this VI. An empty array means the VI was analyzed with no findings surfaced.

test.description: The VI Analyzer test name (e.g. 'Icon Overlap').

result.description: pass = the test passed; fail = the test flagged the VI; error = the test could not evaluate.
